Likely they mean: compute HCF of (45,60)=15. Then compute HCF of (15,90,120). But HCF of three numbers is HCF(HCF(15,90),120). HCF(15,90)=15. Then HCF(15,120)=15. So result 15.

Alternatively, maybe they want HCF(15,90)=15, then HCF(15,120)=15. So final answer 15.

Similarly for second part: HCF(36,48)=12. Then HCF(12,72,96). HCF(12,72)=12. HCF(12,96)=12. So final 12.

Thus answer: first chain yields 15; second chain yields 12.
